name: Apprenticeship — Draft POST then Approve (2627 AY)
description: POSTs a draft apprenticeship learner to the LearnerData Outer API with the apprenticeship starting in the 2627 academic year (running 2 years), waits for the draft to land, then fires ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent to approve it — exercises FLP-2009's AddLearningCommandHandler approval branch (ApprenticeshipLearningDomainModel.Approve) against a real draft created by FLP-1537's POST path.
